id: title:Gilbert09:stop reporting a spurious postgres cancel as an exception

review.posthog_relevance: Postgres warehouse connector recovery and user-facing error handling
review.reason: Adds a database error message to the set of retryable errors, accompanied by a comment explaining the distinction between client-side and external cancellations.
review.uncertainty: The tier relies on the supplied observations; no independent verification of actual recovery behavior or user benefit is available. The tier assumes the connector implementation and relevant checks are visible, but the provided observations do not show the complete implementation or relevant checks.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Adds a new error message constant and its use in the retry-exhausted error mapping.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a user-facing explanation for database statement cancellations that are not caused by PostHog's own client-side deadline, distinguishing them from recoverable transient failures.

observations.behavior: Adds a database error message to the set of retryable errors, accompanied by a comment explaining the distinction between client-side and external cancellations.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Postgres warehouse connector to treat database statement cancellations by the user or pooler as recoverable, preventing premature exhaustion of retry attempts.

observations.behavior: Maps the database error message to the newly defined user-facing message in the retry-exhausted error dictionary.
observations.posthog_connection: Associates the database error with the explanatory message, ensuring users receive the correct guidance when this specific error occurs.
